BinFile.title: BinFile
BinFile.description: Represents a binary file loaded into the system for ECU tuning.

id.description: Unique identifier for the BIN file.

name.description: The name of the BIN file.

uploadDate.description: The date and time when the BIN file was uploaded.

checksum.description: Checksum of the BIN file for integrity verification.

fileSizeBytes.description: Size of the BIN file in bytes.

XdfFile.title: XdfFile
XdfFile.description: Represents an XDF (ECU definition) file loaded into the system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the XDF file.

name.description: The name of the XDF file.

uploadDate.description: The date and time when the XDF file was uploaded.

fileSizeBytes.description: Size of the XDF file in bytes.

EcuMap.title: EcuMap
EcuMap.description: Represents an ECU map definition extracted from an XDF file.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ECU map.

name.description: The name of the ECU map.

address.description: Memory address of the map in the BIN file.

rows.description: Number of rows in the map.

cols.description: Number of columns in the map.

dataSize.description: Size of each data element in the map (in bytes).

isBigEndian.description: Indicates if the data is stored in big-endian format.

equation.description: Equation used to convert raw data values to real-world values.

LogEntry.title: LogEntry
LogEntry.description: Represents a single log entry with test data.

id.description: Unique identifier for the log entry.

rpm.description: Engine RPM at the time of the log entry.

carga.description: Engine load percentage at the time of the log entry.

afr.description: Air-Fuel Ratio at the time of the log entry.

TuningSession.title: TuningSession
TuningSession.description: Represents a single tuning session, linking together the BIN file, XDF file, ECU map, and any modifications made.

id.description: Unique identifier for the tuning session.

tuningDate.description: Date and time when the tuning session was performed.

aggressiveness.description: User-defined aggressiveness setting applied during map correction.

modifiedMapData.description: JSON string of the map after AI modification.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to organize data related to ECU tuning, focusing on binary files, XDF files, ECU maps, log entries, and tuning sessions. The structure follows the principles of Authorization Independence, Structural Segregation, and Access Modeling. The core principle is to ensure easy debuggability. 

Authorization Independence is achieved by not relying on hierarchical `get()` calls in security rules. Instead, authorization information is embedded or derived directly from the document or the document path itself.

Structural Segregation is enforced by keeping data with similar access control requirements in the same collections. For instance, all user-owned data is stored under the `/users/{userId}` path.

Access Modeling leverages path-based ownership for private user data and uses the Membership Map pattern where applicable, although in this schema, path-based ownership is favored due to the clear 1:N relationships between Users and their associated entities.

The structure ensures the QAPs by using clearly defined paths for user-owned data, thus enabling secure `list` operations using path-based security rules. The use of explicit ownership via `/users/{userId}` makes it simple to restrict data access based on the authenticated user's ID.
